fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (SNDK) stock price declined 14% by 11 a.m. Friday when an 8-for-1 stock split took effect, falling from $750 to $81 per share after split adjustment.
fields.summary_ko.1: The decline accelerated due to TrendForce's weak demand forecast for NAND flash memory in 2027, with concerns that reduced enterprise SSD memory orders from Chinese cloud providers will offset increased U.S. AI demand.
fields.summary_ko.2: SNDK has secured approximately half of 2027 NAND bit supply and about two-thirds of 2028 supply through long-term contracts, but concerns remain about the impact of falling NAND prices on profitability after contract expiration.
